description_en: This operation searches for instances based on specified parameters
description_zh: 根据传入参数搜索实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun alidns search-cloud-gtm-instances --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --instance-id gtm-cn-wwo3a3h0000 --instance-name test --charge-type prepay_/_postpay --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchCloudGtmInstances

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese.

en-US: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回值的语言，取值：

zh-CN：中文。
en-US：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the scheduling instance. Fuzzy search is supported
parameters.help_zh: 调度实例名称，支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: instance_name

CommodityCode.description_en:

dns_gtm_public_cn: The commodity code for the China site (aliyun.com).

dns_gtm_public_intl: The commodity code for the international site (alibabacloud.com)

商品编码：

dns_gtm_public_intl：国际站商品编码

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp that indicates when the instance was created

ExpireTime.description_en: The time when the instance expires

ExpireTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp that indicates when the instance expires

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the scheduling instance

MonitorTaskQuota.description_en: The quota for health check tasks

MonthlyEmailUsed.description_en: The number of emails sent in the current month

MonthlySmsQuota.description_en: The monthly quota for text messages. This feature is available only on the China site (aliyun.com)
MonthlySmsQuota.description_zh: 短息配额，仅中国站支持短消息，国际站不支持短消息

MonthlySmsUsed.description_zh: 当月短信发送量，仅中国站支持短信，国际站不支持短信

MonthlyWebhookUsed.description_en: The number of webhook notifications sent in the current month

ScheduleDomainName.description_en: The access domain name for GTM. The domain name is formed by combining the host record (ScheduleHostname) and the domain name (ScheduleZoneName)
ScheduleDomainName.description_zh: GTM接入域名。格式为接入域名主机记录（ScheduleHostname参数值）+主域或子域（ScheduleZoneName参数值）

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was last modified
UpdateTime.description_zh: 实例最后一次修改时间

UpdateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp that indicates when the instance was last modified
UpdateTimestamp.description_zh: 实例最后一次修改时间（时间戳）

ultimate: Ultimate Edition

standard：标准版

ultimate：旗舰版

PageNumber.description_en: The number of the returned page. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20

TotalItems.description_en: The total number of instances found
TotalItems.description_zh: 搜索出来的实例总条目数
